## 1) Implemented optimizations (from repo state + `AI_CHANGELOG.md`)

**High priority (2026-05-11 — “Chat Efficiency”)** — documented in `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md` around the “Chat Efficiency: Cursorignore, Governance Dedup, Progress Feed Policy” entry:

- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursorignore`** — excludes `logs/debug/**` and `**/*bundle*.js` (and intends to exclude Moon Princess capture dir; see gaps below).
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`** — shortened to pointer-first guidance (conflict gate, QA opt-in, aliases, pipeline discovery).
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md`** — progress-feed policy split (full structured vs one-liner in dense loops) and governance/dedup note in workflow section.

**Medium priority (2026-05-11 — M1/M2/M3)** — same changelog block “Medium-Impact Workflow Optimizations”:

- **M1:** `AI_DOCS.md` §11–12 and **`.cursor/skills/axel-simulated-qa/SKILL.md`** trimmed to point at **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\qa\AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md`** for commands.
- **M2:** Bot detail in `AI_DOCS.md` reduced to a pointer at bots README.
- **M3:** Scene dialogue content split into **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\scenes\AXEL_SCENES_ARC1.md` … `AXEL_SCENES_ARC8.md`**; **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\scenes\AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md`** is the TOC; **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\scenes\SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md`** and **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\tools\scene_builder\layout_planner.py`** updated for the new layout.

**Already in place and relevant to your file list (pre-/parallel to 2026-05-11):**

- QA stack under **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\qa\`** (rubric, run log, analytics md/svg).
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\tools\qa\update_qa_analytics.py`** — run-log JSON payloads, Mermaid + SVG trends, `Bots` aggregate line with gap handling, item-balance section when payloads include `item_balance`.

## 2) Likely remaining low-maintenance tasks (exact paths)

| Issue | Paths |
|--------|--------|
| **`.cursorignore` path does not match on-disk exports folder** — pattern is `AXEL/axel_project/exports/moon_princess_files/**` but the repo has **`AXEL/axel_project/exports/Moon Princess Files\`** (space + casing). Bundles may still be caught by `**/*bundle*.js`, but **`main.js` / `browser.js` / CSS / hashed assets** under that folder are likely still indexed. | `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursorignore` |
| **Canon still names the old folder** | `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md` (hierarchy + combat section reference `exports/moon_princess_files/*`) |
| **Stale relative pointers** (still say `plans/AI_*.md` instead of `plans/core/…`) | `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\test\bots\README.md` |
| **Optional index fence for large non-code exports** (only if those PDFs are big enough to matter for your typical chats) | e.g. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\Viral Forge\` — not in `.cursorignore` today |
| **Historical changelog noise** — many older entries list `AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md` paths that may not match the current `plans/core/` layout; low risk to leave append-only, optional one-line “archive paths” note at top of changelog if you want less agent confusion. | `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md` |

No extra work is **required** inside `AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/*` or `update_qa_analytics.py` for “low maint” beyond normal runs after log edits; the script already falls back to legacy paths if `plans/qa` were missing.

---

## 3) Safest implementation order

1. **Align facts in `AI_DOCS.md`** — update the Moon Princess export path to whatever the repo actually uses (e.g. `Moon Princess Files`) so hierarchy and agents match the filesystem before changing ignore rules.
2. **Fix `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursorignore`** — add the real directory pattern (or one broad `exports/**` exception only for captures—**your** choice based on whether you still want other exports indexed).
3. **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\test\bots\README.md`** — point “Plan-step 4” references at `plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md` and `plans/core/AI_DOCS.md`.
4. **Optional** — add ignore rules for other bulky, reference-only trees (e.g. Viral Forge PDFs) after a quick size check; append **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md`** when done per governance.

That ordering keeps **canon → tooling → consumers → optional fences → changelog**, so you do not train agents on a path you are about to delete or rename.

---

**Executive summary:** The 2026-05-11 HIGH and MEDIUM workflow optimizations in `AI_CHANGELOG.md` are reflected in `.cursorignore`, the slim governance rule, `AI_DOCS.md` workflow/progress text, QA pointer hierarchy, scene TOC split, and `layout_planner.py`. The main **unclosed** low-effort item is **path alignment for Moon Princess captures** between `.cursorignore`, `AI_DOCS.md`, and the actual `exports/Moon Princess Files` tree, plus **small pointer fixes** in `test/bots/README.md`. Safest sequence: fix canon text, then `.cursorignore`, then README, then optional export PDF fences and a changelog entry.
